name: ALPHA
recent: Alpha IVF Group Berhad 近期完成从 ACE Market 转板至 Main Market 的股东特别大会决议，并宣布首次单层中期股息每股 0.25 仙。公司董事 Dato' Dr Lee Soon Soo 在公开市场多次增持股份。最新季度（2026年8月31日止）营收环比增长 1.6%，但净利同比下滑 5.9%。
notable: 股东特别大会通过修改公司章程以促成从 ACE Market 转板至 Main Market 的特别决议。
宣布首次单层中期股息每股 0.25 仙，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 24 日，派发日为 2027 年 1 月 13 日。
董事 Dato' Dr Lee Soon Soo 于 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
risks: 最新季度净利同比下滑 5.9%，尽管营收同比增长 5.7%。
公司持续进行股份回购（SBB），可能影响股本结构。
earnings: 2026年8月31日止季度营收为 MYR 52.879 million，环比增长 1.6%，同比增长 5.7%；净利为 MYR 15.115 million，环比增长 8.7%，但同比下降 5.9%；净利率为 28.6%，高于上一季度的 26.7%。

recent_en: Alpha IVF Group Berhad recently passed an EGM resolution to transfer its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market, and declared a first single-tier interim dividend of 0.25 sen per share. Director Dato' Dr Lee Soon Soo acquired shares multiple times in the open market. For the latest quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue rose 1.6% QoQ but net profit fell 5.9% YoY.
notable_en: EGM passed a special resolution to amend the Company's Constitution to facilitate the transfer of listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market.
Declared a first single-tier interim dividend of 0.25 sen per share, with ex-date on 24 Dec 2026 and payment date on 13 Jan 2027.
Director Dato' Dr Lee Soon Soo acquired shares in the open market multiple times between October and November 2026.
risks_en: Latest quarter net profit declined 5.9% YoY despite revenue growing 5.7% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue was MYR 52.879 million, up 1.6% QoQ and 5.7% YoY; net profit was MYR 15.115 million, up 8.7% QoQ but down 5.9% YoY; net margin was 28.6%, higher than 26.7% in the previous quarter.
